propositions: verify-identity.yaml mounts the tickets store via git worktree at lines 41–52 and rebar verify-identity scans real events without exiting 2 (store-not-found).
The CI gate posture is advisory (exit 0) because identity.require_authenticated defaults to false; enforcement is config-driven, not hard-forced by CLI flags.
Grandfathering boundary is controlled by REBAR_IDENTITY_ENFORCE_SINCE (CI env var override in workflow env block) which overrides identity.enforce_since (rebar.toml).
When enforcement is later flipped on, the grandfathering boundary must be set to an appropriate ref so pre-enforcement unsigned events are grandfathered and the gate does not fail spuriously.
docs/identity.md must document the store mount confirmation, advisory posture rationale, and the CI-vs-local distinction between REBAR_IDENTITY_ENFORCE_SINCE and rebar.toml configuration.
